visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoors in a muddy play area, a young boy wearing a tan hat, yellow safety vest, and brown overalls digs in a thick layer of grey mud with a metal shovel. A woman in a wide-brimmed sun hat and apron kneels beside him, assisting with a small yellow shovel. (2) Under a white tent on a green lawn, a woman in a brown dress and orange hard hat points to a chalkboard with drawings of house construction while speaking to a group of children sitting on a wooden bench, all wearing orange hard hats and yellow vests. (3) The boy is seen sitting on a small yellow toy excavator on a gravel surface, holding the handles as if operating it, with several other toy construction vehicles scattered nearby. (4) The boy carries a single red brick across a paved area. (5) Using a small yellow hammer, the boy taps on a wall made of large orange foam blocks. (6) The boy uses a paintbrush to apply pink liquid to a large cardboard house structure. (7) An adult man in a striped shirt and the boy lean over a white tub filled with soapy water and foam, scrubbing small yellow plastic construction trucks. (8) Back in the mud, the boy uses a small metal trowel to scoop mud into a black bucket; he wears yellow cartoon-themed shoes. (9) The boy uses a brush to 'paint' yellow and purple colors onto wooden toy meat and chicken legs placed on a small metal grill. (10) On a grassy lawn, the boy jumps on a plastic stomp rocket launcher, sending a foam rocket into the air as the man in the striped shirt watches from behind. (11) The boy sits in a yellow toy car and slides down a metal slide onto the grass. (12) The boy is seen driving the yellow toy car across the lawn toward an inflatable brown horse. (13) A close-up shows the boy's hands pouring pink soap from a bottle over toy trucks in a foamy tub. (14) The boy stands at a circular black tray, manipulating a small toy tower crane and various toy bulldozers and rollers on a simulated construction site.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天換上工人服來當 一日做工的人. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們先聽了故事 學到怎麼蓋出最堅固的房子 大家都超專心的. (3) [Subtitle]: 接著動手開挖土機 搬磚 蓋房 每個小朋友都變身 工地小幫手 超有成就感. (4) [Subtitle]: 還有刷油漆 洗水泥車 體驗工地日常 感覺自己也變的超專業. (5) [Subtitle]: 接著去泥巴裡找寶石 每次挖到的寶石都好開心. (6) [Subtitle]: 最後還能一起來辦家家酒 烤肉. (7) [Subtitle]: 體驗結束還能到戶外遊玩 大家玩得超開心 結束這充實的一天. (8) [Subtitle]: 今天動手做了很多有趣的事 真是超好玩的體驗.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM. A female narrator speaks with an enthusiastic, high-pitched, and friendly tone. In the background, the distinctive squelching and splashing of wet mud are clearly audible as the main child interacts with it. (2) As the narrator transitions to describing the story session, the background noise floor shifts to a clean, quiet outdoor ambiance. The BGM remains steady with a light piano melody joining the guitar. (3) Rhythmic, percussive thudding sounds occur in sync with the visual of hammering on foam. The narrator’s voice remains energetic, with frequent rising intonations to emphasize excitement. (4) Splashy water sounds and the rubbing of plastic toys become the dominant sound effect as the narration describes washing the trucks. The BGM tempo feels consistent and upbeat. (5) Mud squelching sounds return momentarily. The narrator continues at a steady pace with clear articulation. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' sound signifies the stomp rocket launch, followed by a soft thud. (7) A loud metallic friction sound with a slight rattling quality is heard, corresponding to the child sliding down a metal slide. Faint child laughter is audible. (8) Water splashing and liquid pouring sounds return briefly as the narrator concludes. The BGM gently fades out as the voiceover ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a child's immersive participation in a construction-themed experiential educational event, highlighting the variety of hands-on activities and the enjoyment derived from the process.
